title: Kishin Hishou Demonbane

guide_target.label: 機神飛翔デモンベイン 通常版（2006年PC DVD-ROM版）

routes.title: 通常END（初回クリア）
routes.notes: Linear/no-choice first run; normal ending unlocks both later endings. No verifiable character-specific route portrait applies to this ending section.

routes.title: ドクター・ウェストEND（クリア後）
routes.notes: Start a fresh post-clear run. Winning the BATTLE:02 破壊ロボ vs デモンベイン・ブラッド battle ends that run immediately. Ending section, not a character route: no character-specific portrait.

routes.title: TRUE END（クリア後）
routes.notes: Start a fresh post-clear run, deliberately do not win West's early battle, then enter the special command during the final boss's finishing-move input window. Ending section: no character-route portrait.

sources.title: 機神飛翔デモンベイン — ながながブログ (2006-06-14)
sources.notes: Directly inspected contemporaneous Japanese first-hand ending guide. Covers linear/no-choice structure; first-clear unlocking both hidden endings; the optional 破壊ロボ vs デモンベイン・ブラッド win for West END with combat tips; and final-battle 必滅奥義 input for TRUE END. Applies to the original May 2006 PC game.

sources.title: 機神飛翔デモンベイン クリア — シバッチの世間話 (2006-06-11)
sources.notes: Independent contemporaneous Japanese first-hand play report with specific first-clear and TRUE END instructions, final-boss tactics, and tested rebinding 上=S, 下=D, 攻=A followed by SDSA. Direct article text available via search inspection; later direct open timed out. This component supports normal/true ending steps, not West END.

sources.title: 機神咆吼デモンベイン — スーパーロボット大戦UX攻略＆まとめwiki
sources.notes: Independent Japanese reference specifically describes the 機神飛翔 sequel's normally unwinnable Doctor West battle and ending caused by winning it. It is not a choice guide for the separate 機神咆吼 predecessor. Combined with B's contemporaneous battle/ending sources to verify West END.

sources.title: サブタイトル — 我がメモ帳 @ ウィキ
sources.notes: Directly inspected Japanese BATTLE episode index for 機神飛翔, identifying BATTLE:02 アイム・ロックンロール！ as スーパーウェスト無敵ロボ28號 vs デモンベイン・ブラッド. Placement/label evidence; not independent ending-conditions evidence.

disagreements: Target explicitly restricted to the Nitroplus original 2006 Japanese Windows PC 通常版, not 斬魔大聖 or 機神咆吼. DX and regular share original-game progression; Set B's blogger owned DX, so his ending observations apply to the shared in-game content, not DX-only pack-in material. Set A is a contemporaneous first-hand ending walkthrough. Set B is composite: Shibachi independently verifies normal/true ending mechanics, and Japanese reference pages independently verify West's early battle, win consequence, and battle number. The SDSA keyboard trick is described in B, while A confirms the input is shown after Normal END; no fabricated verbatim Set-A command is inserted. Both post-clear routes are presented as full fresh runs because no explicit primary-source save/load point was located. No invented saves are used. This is an ending-completion guide for a linear hybrid novel/action game, not a full battle guide. No route characters exist; no route-character portraits are applicable. Cover verified: Nitroplus official 2006 game page labels its displayed image 〖ジャケット画像〗; image link directly resolves to https://www.nitroplus.co.jp/game/images/05_demon_hisyo.jpg and is used in catalog.json. No owner-specific source-gate exception is requested or invoked.
